title: High Adventure Days
transcription:
High Adventure Day

We love high adventure,
We love Cherry Cove,
Suffering is a joy to us,
The dusty trails our home.

We love guiding boy scouts,
so we will defend,
Wednesday High Adventure day,
to the very end.

We love high adventure,
We love, Cherry Cove.
